# moin

> moin deploys apps to servers you own, backs up every change of their SQLite database to your own bucket and lets you edit the data live. It works from the web, the moin CLI, a terminal UI, a JSON API and an MCP server for AI agents. Open source under AGPL-3.0.

Every docs page is also available as Markdown: add .md to its URL.

## Docs

- [Introduction](/docs/introduction): What moin is and how its pieces fit
- [Getting Started](/docs/getting-started): From a fresh server to a live app
- [Self-hosting](/docs/self-hosting): Run all of moin yourself, free
- [Deploy](/docs/guides/deploy): Deploy, redeploy and roll back apps
- [Backups](/docs/guides/backups): Every change of every SQLite database in your own bucket
- [AI agents (MCP)](/docs/guides/mcp): Let Claude and other agents run moin
- [CLI](/docs/reference/cli): Every moin command
- [API](/docs/reference/api): The JSON API under /api/v1
- [FAQ](/docs/faq): Common questions
- [Roadmap](/docs/roadmap): Now, next and later
- [Changelog](/changelog): What shipped, newest first
